answer: Jury of five, slash on divergence: if two graders disagree past the tolerance, the claimant loses its bond and the claim pays nothing. Cleared amounts vest over eight epochs instead of paying at once, so a farm cannot cash out and vanish. Take a market where agents appraise lots, opal parcels or juniper crates: each appraisal needs five independent graders, so faking a quorum means running five times the accounts through eight epochs of vesting. That is the only bridge from work to reward.
